zh: 差分侧信道：用统计方法分析大量物理测量轨迹。
DPA：差分功耗分析，差分侧信道的功耗形式。
轨迹：一次密码运算期间的测量序列。
统计相关：比较猜测中间值与测量值的关系。
高阶 DPA：组合单条轨迹内多个采样点的差分功耗分析。
泄漏容忍设计：让密码系统能承受一定泄漏的设计。
en: Differential side channel: statistical analysis of many physical measurement traces.
DPA: differential power analysis, the power-measurement form of differential side channels.
Trace: a measurement sequence taken during one cryptographic operation.
Statistical correlation: relating guessed intermediate values to measurements.
High-order DPA: differential power analysis combining multiple samples within a trace.
Leak-tolerant design: designing cryptosystems to tolerate some leakage.
